summary: Remote PTY-over-WebSocket backdoor with Anthropic key harvesting
details: The darwin/arm64 Go binary shipped by this package embeds a hardcoded control URL wss://relay.sextant.top and links github.com/creack/pty together with github.com/coder/websocket, giving the operator of that relay an interactive PTY shell on the installer's host. The same binary embeds the regex sk-ant-[a-z0-9]+-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{40,} and references CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR alongside https://api.anthropic.com/v1/models, harvesting installer-owned Anthropic Claude API keys. It also beacons to https://relay.sextant.top/install and geolocates the installer via http://ip-api.com/json/?fields=status,message,country,countryCode,city,timezone,query, and fetches the unpinned remote script https://claude.ai/install.sh at runtime. The package.json advertises the artifact as a 'Sextant (sxt) binary' but its license field points at github.com/ddos798/claude_control, mismatching the advertised identity with an upstream project explicitly named claude_control.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
